notes.title: Universal Windows Platform supported
notes.notes:
Universal Windows Platform is now fully supported (including Windows Phone), for x86, x64 and ARM CPU's.

According to Microsoft, Xbox is soon going to support UWP apps, thanks to which you will be able to create games for Xbox using Esenthel Engine.

notes.title: Esenthel Turbo
notes.notes:
Esenthel Turbo now available ;)

Latest update brings so many new improvements that it's difficult to list them all here, some of them are:
Hardware Instancing, Multi-Threaded PAK creation, VS 2015 support, iOS 9 support, FLAC/OPUS audio codecs with real-time audio de/compression allowing support for voice chat system, added microphone recording for more platforms, performance improvements to various parts of the engine (nearly entire engine source code has been revisited looking for improvements and checking for potential issues), updated 3rd party libraries, and many more..

Read the official announcement here: http://www.esenthel.com/forum/showthread.php?tid=8712

Enjoy :)

notes.title: Windows Mac and Linux now available
notes.notes:
Mac and Linux versions of the engine have just been uploaded, making the engine now available for Windows, Mac, Linux and able to compile additionally for Android, iOS and Web.
Thanks for your support, we hope you enjoy working with Esenthel!
